'''Ed Rebman ISB Space''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Ed Rebman]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-15614">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15614 ISB Space], DeckTech (Ed "eddiehectic" Rebman, 27 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15614/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15614/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Ed Rebman]]
* '''Published:''' 27 April 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''ISB Space''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif|label=ISB Operations}}

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 ISB Rebman DS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]] (omits Grabber: not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' Big Blue ISB space with IC.  No strategy posted, if you feel you cannot rate this deck without it, please don't rate at all.  Thnx
